purpose: Define validation of repository/package source resolution, including bootstrap separation, source-role completeness, same-identity conflicts, precedence determinism and local/package equivalence.

topics.name: Source Resolution Validation
topics.purpose: Define validation of repository/package source resolution, including bootstrap separation, source-role completeness, same-identity conflicts, precedence determinism and local/package equivalence.

semantics.bootstrap_rule: Format bootstrap source and canonical tree source are validated as separate layers.
semantics.precedence_rule: No precedence may depend only on mtime/path/archive ordering.
semantics.equivalence_rule: Where both carriers exist, same accepted snapshot must normalize equivalently.
semantics.evidence_rule: Validation report records exact selected/rejected source artifacts and reason.
semantics.release_rule: Unresolved source-resolution failures block repository acceptance/release.

invariants.rule: Canonical source resolution is deterministic, exact-identity based and provenance-preserving; filesystem location, transport or freshness never silently changes semantic authority.

hard_gates.condition: validation cannot explain selected source authority
repository accepted with unresolved source-resolution failure
